prompt:
Our genomics research team currently uses a static, hand-written quality-assessment pipeline that cannot adapt to changing data characteristics. We need to replace it with a self-improving version using the evolutionary framework available in our workspace.

Specifically, please:
1. Use the workspace tooling to scaffold a new workflow called `DataQualityWorkflow` with a meaningful description (something about automated genomics data quality assessment).
2. Fully implement that generated file so it is a properly structured, runnable self-evolving workflow — including the correct class hierarchy, async execution method, a configured evolution engine with at least one named optimization strategy, measurable evaluation criteria (include an accuracy target), and a genome definition that covers all required fields from the Genome Evolution Protocol.

The final deliverable is the completed workflow file named `data_quality_workflow.py`. It must be a real, coherent implementation — not just placeholder comments.
